      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_07</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_SiteVisitJoin" name="Evaluation complete">

      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_07</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_08</bpmn:outgoing>

      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_09</bpmn:outgoing>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_NegotiateContract" name="Negotiate contract terms">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_09</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_10</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_SignContract" name="Sign contract">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_10</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_11</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_OnboardSupplier" name="Onboard supplier">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_11</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_12</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Onboarded" name="Supplier onboarded and contract executed">

    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_01" sourceRef="StartEvent_NeedIdentified" targetRef="Task_IssueRFP"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_02" sourceRef="Task_IssueRFP" targetRef="Task_ReceiveProposals"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_03" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveProposals" targetRef="Task_EvaluateProposals"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_04" sourceRef="Task_EvaluateProposals" targetRef="Gateway_SiteVisitSplit"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_07" sourceRef="Task_SiteVisitsInterviews" targetRef="Gateway_SiteVisitJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_08" sourceRef="Gateway_SiteVisitJoin" targetRef="Task_SelectSupplier"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_09" sourceRef="Task_SelectSupplier" targetRef="Task_NegotiateContract"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_10" sourceRef="Task_NegotiateContract" targetRef="Task_SignContract"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_11" sourceRef="Task_SignContract" targetRef="Task_OnboardSupplier"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_12" sourceRef="Task_OnboardSupplier" targetRef="EndEvent_Onboarded"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
